numeric_method: Recorded positions rounded to 0.001 m; seven post-release points/run. Origin-constrained least squares x=m t²; independent g=2m. Graphs show per-run fits only, never a series/pooled estimate. Prospective audit: first-free frame remains the nominal time/position reference. True release is bracketed one-sided by the preceding frame. Actual release sensitivity with fixed first-free position reference uses q=t²+2δt. Original ±frame t-only values remain explicitly exploratory.
